name: Control & Policy Networks
description: Neural network architectures (SVNet, PAVE, SIFU, DNNet, feature extractors) and the pilot/policy classes that wrap them to produce flight control commands.

name: Flight Deployment
description: Real-world and FiGS-based simulated flight execution, drone command dispatch, and rollout deployment of trained pilots.

name: Training & Instruction
description: Loss functions, synthesized-data loading, and the training loop used to teach pilot policies from expert-generated flight data.

name: Data Synthesis
description: Generation and compression of synthetic vision-and-inertial training data by rolling out expert trajectories through Gaussian-splat scenes.

name: Shared Utilities & Visualization
description: Cross-cutting math/parameter helpers plus plotting, console-reporting, and flight-recording utilities consumed by the flight, synthesize, and control layers.

name: Configuration
description: JSON configuration data defining camera capture profiles, flight courses, training/evaluation methods, network I/O schemas, pilot definitions, and scene frames that parameterize the control and synthesis code.

name: Documentation & Examples
description: The project's public GitHub Pages website (HTML/CSS/JS, including vendored Bulma carousel/slider assets) and the example notebooks demonstrating FiGS and SousVide usage end to end.

name: Project Metadata & Environment
description: Repository-level project description, Python packaging metadata, the Conda environment definition, and the FiGS git submodule wiring that set up the research codebase's build and runtime environment.
